notes.title: Farm Simulator Devlog #1: Sowing the Seeds of Progress! 🚜🌾
notes.notes:
Greetings, fellow farmers! 

It's time for a little peek behind the barn doors to showcase the incredible strides we've been making in the world of Farm Simulator. Our tractors have been buzzing, and the fields have been ripe for some serious action!

🚜 Prepping the Soil
The team has been hard at work sculpting the digital earth for your farming adventures. In our latest devlog, feast your eyes on the initial steps of preparing the fields for planting. The soil has been meticulously crafted to mimic the real deal, ensuring your virtual crops get the best start possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276183/4bf04753f6e619da861aced4f42501b24c485425.gif[/img]

🌱 Planting Season Begins
But wait, there's more! We're thrilled to share a sneak peek at the planting process. Watch as your farmer avatar expertly sows the first seeds of potatoes and corn. The attention to detail will make you feel the virtual dirt between your fingers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276183/2633aee76eb3c137f808ef6c42602b1510036237.gif[/img]

💼 Full Steam Ahead
Production is in full swing here at Farm Simulator HQ. Our virtual farm is a hive of activity as we bring to life the intricacies of farming. And this is just the beginning! In upcoming devlogs, we'll be treating you to even more behind-the-scenes magic, showcasing how the game is shaping up in real-time.

🌾 Let the Farming Adventures Begin!
Thank you for being a part of this incredible journey. Keep those overalls on, grab your virtual pitchfork, and stay tuned for more exciting updates. The harvest is just around the corner!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2334600/Family_Land__Farmer_Simulator/

👨‍🌾 Happy farming, everyone! 🚜🌾

notes.title: Welcome to the Prologue of Family Land - Farmer Simulator! 🌽 🚜
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276183/a1095ba1706eb68157ec15c617dc7df7f5c9b297.png[/img]

[h2]Hello, Farmers![/h2]

We are excited to welcome you to the Prologue of Family Land - Farmer Simulator! This is your chance to dive into the world of farming and get hands-on with the core mechanics and gameplay elements that will be central to the full version of the game. The Prologue offers just a small taste of the farming life that awaits you, but there's plenty to explore!

[h3][b]A First Look at Farm Life[/b][/h3]
In the Prologue, you’ll step into the role of Uncle Henry, preparing essential notes and advice for young John, which will be invaluable in the full version of the game. You’ll start by familiarizing yourself with the tools available on the farm, taking on the daily responsibilities of a farmer—mowing grass, tilling soil, fertilizing fields, and planting your first crops, starting with corn. Along the way, you'll meet the Williams family, who will help guide you through the journey of managing a farm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276183/d13f3f15746598f6f1cd5179e737f1e8aa1b717a.gif[/img]

[h3][b]What You’ll Learn[/b][/h3]
Throughout the Prologue, you’ll experience the entire farming cycle. You’ll:
[list]
[*] Spray your crops to protect them
[*] Order fertilizers and supplies
[*] Harvest and sell your produce
[*] Learn how to raise chickens and collect eggs
[/list]

Every task you complete will not only help you grow your farm but will also serve as material for writing a guidebook for city dwellers, teaching them the ways of rural life!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276183/74a80d2ab4cd72093e73e33834431a76865d77dd.gif[/img]

This prologue is just the beginning and will serve as an introduction to the full game. It’s currently undergoing final touches and testing, and we can’t wait to share it with you! Follow our devlogs on the main game page for more updates as we continue developing the full version of [i]Family Land - Farmer Simulator[/i]. Exciting times are ahead—stay tuned!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2334600/Family_Land__Farmer_Simulator/
